newsitem.title: USA: Indigo reiterates no profits before mid-97.
newsitem.headline: Indigo reiterates no profits before mid-97.

text.p: Indigo NV said Wednesday that revenue for its third quarter would be in the range of $20 million to $23 million and reiterated that it does not expect to become profitable before mid-1997.
The company attributed the figures in part to continuing slower-than-expected development of the short-run color printing market.

The company also responded to recent heavy trading in its stock, saying that neither of its two principal shareholders -- the Landa Family Trust and a partnership affiliated with George Soros and Purnendu Chatterjee -- nor any of its senior management, has sold company shares in recent weeks.
